request.description: Original WWII naval tactics game UI sprite sheet. Precisely preserve the supplied separate rectangles, all on transparent empty background. Clean native pixel art on a one pixel grid, thin continuous 1 pixel dark outer border and 1 pixel ivory inner edge, squared corners with tiny 2 pixel corner cuts, very flat matte naval steel. Large completely quiet flat dark teal interiors for dynamic text. Subtle brass corner fasteners only, no texture noise, no glossy shading, no gradients, no blur. Top left small panel, tall contact panel beside it, large lower dialog panel. Right column six blank button state plates, same shape each: normal navy, hover lighter steel, focus ivory rim, pressed darker inset, selected amber rim, disabled desaturated dark. Two empty horizontal meter frames at left middle and a small square icon socket. ALL pieces independent disconnected with transparent gutters. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO symbols, NO logos. UI frames only, never render a game screenshot.

assets.export_operation: Existing17x17 source-pixel template; four8px corners with tiled edge strips and center. Original large crops remain supplementary.
